name: Wild Wild Joker

features.name: Both-ways money collection
features.description: Wild pairs on either side collect connected money symbols.

features.name: Boost and Respin Wilds
features.description: Edge wilds can boost values or respin reels.

features.name: Retriggering free spins
features.description: Every third wild pair adds four spins.

review:
Money collecting that pays both ways. Wilds on reels one and two with money symbols on reels 3–5 (or the mirror image) win every connected money value.

Wilds on reels one and five can turn into Boost Wilds (raising money values) or Respin Wilds (respinning every reel without a wild). A pair of wilds plus a Free Spins symbol on reel three starts eight free spins, and every third wild pair adds four more. Up to 5,000x, 96.49% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
